title: Gahdayum Fart
blurb: The reaction is included in the price. A voice gets half a word out before the blast takes over, a two-second ripper with genuine sustain, and then the verdict arrives: a drawled gahh-dayum of the sort normally reserved for barbecue and highlight reels. Bundling commentary with catastrophe saves editors a job, since one file now supplies both the event and its audience. It plays best over footage of somebody else's mistake, where the drawl does the judging on your behalf. Three and a half seconds, and a complete piece of radio drama.
origin: A fart clip bundled with a drawled 'gahdayum' reaction; the performers are unknown.
